scenarios.title: 1. Verify initial Review desk heading text
scenarios.purpose: Ensure the Review desk heading uses the original capitalization 'Review desk' before the patch changes it to 'Review Desk'.

scenarios.title: 3. Load example diff shows snippet text 'Invoice not found'
scenarios.purpose: Confirm that loading the example diff populates the unified diff textarea with content including the phrase 'Invoice not found' before patch.

scenarios.title: 4. Verify that Index repository context button is disabled initially
scenarios.purpose: Ensure that the 'Index repository context' button is disabled when no pull request URL is entered before patch changes.

scenarios.title: 5. Ensure Analyze change button is disabled with no input and setup required
scenarios.purpose: Check that the analyze change button is disabled when API is not ready and no diff or PR URL is provided before patch.
